tasks.spec:
You are a senior product designer producing a single-file operations metrics board. You work alone, cannot ask questions, and must write exactly two files into your current working directory: design-spec.md and board.html. Do NOT git commit, do NOT call any network resource, do NOT reference external assets (no CDN fonts/scripts/styles) — board.html must be fully self-contained (inline CSS, inline SVG for every graph).

CONTEXT: This board is the daily control surface for a 'loop factory' — an estate of autonomous AI departments (currently: podcast, social) that run scheduled loops, self-heal, and escalate to a human owner (Ankit) only when needed. The v0 prototype was rejected as too dense and too dark. The owner's direction, verbatim intent: 'like an operations metrics board with clear indicators and graphs — very clear on where we are, what's been accomplished relative to the goal, errors/issues; everything else is nice-to-have.'

OWNER DESIGN PREFERENCES (must drive the design): sleek and editorial, NOT AI-generic; full-bleed layout; white space as structure; clean visual lines; clear vertical hierarchy; minimal output. Prefer a light editorial palette with restrained accent colors reserved for state (green ok / amber warn / red critical / purple degraded). Big numbers, thin rules, generous spacing. No decorative gradients, no glassmorphism, no emoji.

INFORMATION PRIORITY (strict, top to bottom):
1. WHERE WE ARE VS GOAL — hero zone: map/build progress toward the goal (synthetic: overall program 14 of 19 tickets closed, build phase 0 of 5; podcast shadow burn-in day 9 of 14; zero external actions taken, as required). Show as large progress graphs, not text lists.
2. HEALTH RIGHT NOW — one glance: 2 departments, podcast healthy, social degraded; ONE critical issue: AUTH_EXPIRED on the codex_oauth lane, 42 minutes, 3 steps queued, fix is the shell command 'codex login'; 2 approvals waiting on the human (oldest 3.1 h).
3. ERRORS / ISSUES — today: podcast 47 runs 46 ok 1 error; social 31 runs 27 ok 3 blocked 1 error; social evaluator pass 83% with 2 revise loops; self-heal activity: 2 auto-patches applied, 0 failed, weekly budget 2 of 10 used.
4. TREND METRICS (7 days) — runs 512, first-try success 91%, auto-heals 11, human escalations 2, babysitting events 2 (down from 9 — show the drop as a graph), tokens 1.9M all on subscription lanes, metered spend 0.
Everything beyond these four zones is OPTIONAL and must not compete visually.

GRAPHS: use inline SVG. At minimum: a progress visualization for zone 1, a bar or dot run-outcome graph for zone 3, and a 7-day trend line or bar sparkline for zone 4. Label axes/values directly on the graph (editorial style), no chart-library look.

The page must visibly carry the label 'PROTOTYPE — synthetic data' somewhere unobtrusive, and a footer note that the live version renders from board-feed.ndjson.

DELIVERABLES:
1. design-spec.md — headed sections covering: Layout (grid + why), Visual hierarchy (what the eye hits 1st/2nd/3rd and why that order serves a daily operator), Indicators & graphs (each graph type chosen and why), Color & state system (exact hex values and what each means), and anything you rejected and why.
2. board.html — the complete self-contained page implementing that spec with the synthetic data above.

A checker will fail you if: either file is missing, board.html references external assets, fewer than 3 inline SVGs exist, any of the four zones is absent, the synthetic/prototype label is missing, or design-spec.md lacks substantive layout/hierarchy/graph sections.
tasks.verified: a self-contained editorial ops-metrics board html with real inline-SVG graphs covering goal-progress, current health, errors, and trends, plus a design spec explaining the choices
